text: Writing the Saltmarsh renewal brief. What discount are we on with Saltmarsh Provisions? I thought Bettina said 12 at some point.
reply_text:
Kwame Adjei-Rowe, you're half right. Bettina did say 12% in this channel, on 2025-11-17. Ten minutes later she retracted it and said the figure is 10%. She had misread a draft worksheet from June Osei-Lark.

So the only figure posted here is 10%, and that comes from Bettina's correction. I can't see a Saltmarsh contract or account file, so I can't confirm it against the signed terms. Before the brief goes out, please check the number with June or Anselm Grieve. A year has also passed since that message, so the rate may have changed.

text: Separate ask from me: who is our main contact at Saltmarsh and what is her title? Moss's Coastal cheat sheet should have it.
reply_text:
Bettina Kroll, the cheat sheet lists Corinne Ashdown as the main contact at Saltmarsh Provisions. Her title is VP Operations.

Her name also appears in this channel's history from the dock-appointment and access issues. The cheat sheet has no date, so it may be out of date.
